paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

model_annotations.English: The line plot is titled "Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations." It shows the mean of the absolute values of hidden states across different layers of a model, comparing three different configurations: pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 23, with a marker every layer number. The y-axis represents the mean value of the absolute hidden states, ranging from 0 to 4 in increments of 1. In the pre-gating configuration, the mean of the absolute hidden states starts at a very low value near zero at layer 0 and increases to a peak of approximately 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating mean (represented by an orange dotted line) remains very close to zero throughout the entire range of layers, with an average value of 0.05. The baseline mean (represented by a green solid line) also remains near zero throughout the range of layers, but has a slightly higher average value of 0.04 compared to the post-gating mean. The plot shows that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification found in deeper layers, as evidenced by the dramatic increase in the pre-gating mean starting at layer 12.
